sloka: इति गर्जन्ति हरयो राघवस्य समीपतः ।पुरस्ताद् ऋषभ्हो वीरो नीलः कुमुद एव च ॥६-४-३०॥।।
transliteration: iti garjanti harayo rāghavasya samīpataḥ ।purastād ṛṣabhho vīro nīlaḥ kumuda eva ca ॥6-4-30॥।।

translations.english: Heroic Rshaba, Nila and even Kumuda together with many vanaras were searching on the way.
